title: UBC Rocket Message Registry
description: Single source of truth for all structured I/O between firmware, ground station, jetson, and tools. Codegen produces C headers (packed structs + auto-generated .proto + nanopb output), the Python decoder library, the routing table, and the host annotation tables. Hand-assigned IDs (module_id, msg_id, cmd_id, channel_id, error code) are stable on the wire — never renumber.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this meta-schema. Ignored by codegen.

version.description: Registry format version. Bump only when the meta-schema itself changes shape.

channels.description: Transport channels available to the publish path. Routing entries in messages reference these by name. Adding a transport means adding an entry here — no codegen code changes.

types.description: User-defined composite types. Reference from any field as 'type:<typename>'. Codegen emits packed sub-structs for Class A, nanopb sub-messages for Class B. Types may reference other types; cycles are rejected by codegen.

modules.description: Modules group related messages/commands/errors. Module names form C identifier prefixes (e.g. servo -> SERVO_*).

channel_id.description: Hand-assigned, stable on the wire. Used in commands like set_route.

transport.description: Transport family. Determines which sink the routing layer fans out to. sd_record = appended to SD log; uart = framed over a UART; udp = packetised over UDP.

framing.description: Wire framing. 'none' for SD (records are length-prefixed inside the log format) and UDP (packet boundaries are intrinsic). 'cobs' for UART streams.

max_wire_bps.description: Channel bandwidth budget in bits/sec. The build-time linter sums max_rate_hz × wire_size across all messages routed here and fails the build if it exceeds this.

transport_config.description: Transport-specific config. Schema is validated by codegen (uart needs uart_id; udp needs port; sd_record needs nothing).

fields.description: Field order is wire order. Same evolution rules as messages — only append.

module_id.description: Hand-assigned, stable on the wire. 0 reserved for 'system'.

class.description: A = packed record, fixed schema, hot path. B = nanopb envelope, flexible schema, sporadic.

request.description: Request payload fields. Always Class B (nanopb).

streaming.description: If true, the command emits multiple response messages until a terminating one. Used for long-running operations (cal sessions, self-tests with progress).

description.description: Human-readable explanation. Rendered by ground tooling when an error appears in a log or on the console. The ONLY place these strings live — firmware never sends them on the wire.

type.description: Primitive (u8/u16/u32/u64/i8/i16/i32/i64/f32/f64/bool), Class B only (string/bytes), user type ref ('type:vec3_m'), enum ref to a specific error ('enum:servo.out_of_range', encodes as u16), or enum ref to a whole module namespace ('enum:servo.errors', encodes as u16, accepts any code in that module). Optional fixed-array suffix: 'f32[3]', 'type:vec3_m[4]'.

units.description: SI or domain unit (e.g. 'm/s', 'rad', 'deg_C', 'us'). Required for physical quantities.

routing.description: Keys must match channel names declared in top-level 'channels'. Codegen rejects routing entries that reference unknown channels. Channels not listed are disabled by default.

enabled.description: Default state at boot. Runtime can toggle via 'system.set_route' until 'system.lock_routes' is called or auto-lock-on-arm fires.

max_rate_hz.description: Class A only. Token-bucket rate limit at the publish path. The build-time bus-budget linter consumes this.
